text: Gardening is a rewarding hobby that demands patience and dedication. The first step in gardening is watering, ensuring your plants receive adequate moisture. Proper watering prevents dryness and promotes healthy growth. Once the roots are well-established, pruning can begin. This essential task shapes the plants and encourages new growth, keeping them tidy and vibrant. After initial care, pruning allows the gardener to refine the plant’s form, maintain balance, and prevent overcrowding. Proper watering and strategic pruning are the foundational practices in any gardening effort.
